## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

## 2. General Approach & Strategy

## 2.1. Purpose

This documentidentifies theHealth and SafetyMinimumStandards to assist those engaged or associated with the undertaking of construction activities of works to assist them in developing and implementing their own management systems and arrangements to meet Contracted and Legislative requirements.

## 2.2. Scope

The Scope of these Construction Health and Safety Minimum Standards apply to all Program Partners engaged or associated with construction related activities, this includes those involved during the design, construction and/orcommissioningphases.
